address: Cone Valley, Woolaston, Nr Lydney, Gloucestershire,GL15 6AD
bio: Swan House Tea Room is situated overlooking the Cone Valley Brook, close to the beautiful Forest of Dean and a wealth of other stunning attractions.  Choose from Classic or Deluxe Afternoon Tea menus, including a selection of finger sandwiches, homemade scones and cakes, served on fine bone china, with unlimited tea or coffee. Upgrade and indulge further with a glass or bottle of Prosecco!  Dietary requirements are catered for, including vegetarian, vegan, dairy free and gluten free.  Advanced booking required.
